features.description: Parse first-party TypeScript/JSX ES imports into as-built ts_module nodes + relative-import edges, contract-stamped; import-type and re-export forms handled; bare/unresolved imports surface as low-confidence unresolved endpoints. Deterministic + bounded, mirroring the JS crawler.
features.acceptance: an extractor scans first-party .ts/.tsx/.jsx files into ts_module nodes (source_path-bearing) plus relative-import edges; import-type and export-from forms are parsed; an import that resolves to nothing surfaces as a low-confidence unresolved endpoint (never dropped); build_view_state includes these nodes/edges with source_kind code.

features.description: Exclude documentation mockups and vendored skill assets from the architecture model + the coverage language scan, and move typescript/jsx from unextracted to extracted, so a repo whose only TS/JSX was non-product is no longer falsely ceiling-capped.
features.acceptance: documentation-mockup and skill-asset trees are excluded from both the extractor scan and the coverage presence scan; typescript and jsx are no longer reported as missing_extractor when first-party TS/JSX is extracted or absent; for DontPanic itself (only non-product TS/JSX) the confidence ceiling is no longer forced low by typescript/jsx.
